_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE audit-analytics demo -- a small population of invoice amounts and journal entries, per this toolkit's market survey of Deloitte/EY/PwC/KPMG audit-analytics tooling (Omnia/Argus, DataSnipper, etc. -- see finmodel/audit_analytics.py's module docstring and docs/BIG4_AUTOMATION.md). NOTE: Benford's Law needs a reasonably large, unconstrained-magnitude population to be statistically meaningful -- this 20-row illustrative sample is deliberately small, so treat its conformity label as a demonstration of the mechanism, not a real finding; see tests/test_audit_analytics.py for a synthetic dataset built to exactly match (and one built to badly violate) the expected distribution.
